text: ① 14:00 英国9月三个月ILO就业人数、失业率； ② 17:00 欧元区10月ZEW经济景气指数，德国10月ZEW经济景气指数； ③ 17:05 欧洲央行管委Rehn讲话； ④ 美股盘前 通用汽车、3M等发布业绩报告； ⑤ 20:30 美国9月新屋开工、营建许可； ⑥ 22:00 美国9月成屋签约销售指数； ⑦ 次日01:00 英国央行货币政策委员Greene讲话； ⑧ 美股盘后 美联航、奈飞发布业绩报告； ⑨ 次日06:30 澳洲联储副主席Hauser讲话； 微信小程序搜索“见闻历”，了解更多。
text_en: ① 14:00 UK September three-month ILO employment change and unemployment rate; ② 17:00 Eurozone October ZEW economic sentiment index, Germany October ZEW economic sentiment index; ③ 17:05 ECB Governing Council member Rehn speaks; ④ Pre-market U.S. stocks: General Motors, 3M and others release earnings reports; ⑤ 20:30 U.S. September housing starts and building permits; ⑥ 22:00 U.S. September pending home sales index; ⑦ Next day 01:00 BoE Monetary Policy Committee member Greene speaks; ⑧ After-hours U.S. stocks: United Airlines and Netflix release earnings reports; ⑨ Next day 06:30 RBA Deputy Governor Hauser speaks; Search "Jianwen Calendar" on WeChat Mini Programs for more.
